messages:
maria_cs: FYI — AcmeCorp submitted their vendor security form during the onboarding call. There are 6 flagged items we need to triage (SOC2 scope, BYOK, KMS residency, embeddings retention, subprocessors, nonprod access).
eli_sec: Can you drop the form link? I'll take SOC2 & KMS residency first.
maria_cs: https://redwood.internal/answers/acmecorp/privacy-form-4521 (internal) — SOC2 answers are partial, they marked 'in-scope' for A.3 but we don't have attestation docs.
ramon_csm: Heads up — renewal is in 8 months and they mentioned needing enterprise SLA/KMS options before committing to Dedicated. This could bump renewal risk if we don't resolve BYOK/KMS.
jess_enable: I can run a quick enablement session for their security contact next week to walk through Dedicated options + KMS integrations. Need the exact list of asks to prep.
maria_cs: Quick status snippet:
```
SOC2: partial (attestation missing)
BYOK: requested (needs design + timeline)
KMS residency: asked for region mapping (EU vs US)
Embeddings retention: wants 13 months + deletion proof
Subprocessors: requested current list + flow diagram
Nonprod access: approval for masked sandbox?
```
sam_eng: For BYOK we can support customer KEKs via KMS by end of quarter but need legal BYOK contract signed. Timeline ~3 weeks for integration testing.
eli_sec: Okay I'll prepare a short evidence pack we can share for SOC2 (scoped controls list + sys logs). Who owns the embed retention proof?
maria_cs: I'll own the embeddings retention response and gather retention SLA + purge demo.
ramon_csm: Action items / owners: Eli -> SOC2 evidence pack (due 3 business days), Sam -> BYOK integration plan & timeline (due 5 business days), Maria -> retention + dataflow diagram (due 4 business days), Jess -> schedule enablement session (target next Tue).
onboarding-bot: Ticket #4521 created and assigned to customer-success:acme — due date 1740086399.
jess_enable: Can everyone add any customer-facing docs/snippets to the shared folder: /cs/onboarding/acmecorp/answers before EOD? I'll pull slides from there.
eli_sec: Adding SOC2 checklist now. Maria — will ping you if I need clarifications on the retention policy.
maria_cs: thanks — I'll start drafting answers and ping legal for BYOK contract template.
ramon_csm: Will follow up in 48h and escalate to AM if any blockers on BYOK/legal. :eyes: 
sam_eng: Noted. I'll post a short runbook for the integration steps in the folder once we validate.
jess_enable: Great, let's aim to close the flagged items this sprint so renewal risk stays low. :thumbsup:
